recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow source-page correction that restores the approved FHIR-25896 meaning without touching generated artifacts.
issue_request: FHIR-25896 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested text explaining that the page lists value sets defined in the FHIR core specification, not value sets defined in implementation guides outside core, and that additional value sets may be found in FHIR implementation guides, HL7 Terminology, and the FHIR registry.
initial_application: Commit 2fab905a90 previously applied FHIR-25896 to source/terminologies-valuesets.html, but the applied wording collapsed HL7 Terminology into the exclusion clause and said additional value sets may be found in "FHIR implementation guides in the FHIR registry", which did not clearly convey the approved THO and registry discovery guidance.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml includes terminologies-valuesets.html under the Terminology module, confirming the edited page is in current build scope. FHIR-I Confluence minutes record the Persuasive with Modification motion for FHIR-25896, and Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Updated source/terminologies-valuesets.html to say implementation-guide value sets outside core are not listed and that additional value sets may be found in FHIR implementation guides, published at HL7 Terminology, or captured in the FHIR registry.
source_changes: source/terminologies-valuesets.html: clarified the introductory paragraph for the Value Sets Defined in FHIR page.
